arm_schedule: sequential arms; two independent repeat lanes per arm

preregistered_harness_conditions.comparison: Fresh actual HTTP before and after; V8 native is a different historical harness, never a paired substitute.
preregistered_harness_conditions.identity_freeze: One runner byte SHA must be recorded before the first V9 trial and used unchanged in both arms. Record immutable baseline and candidate source/config/model/prompt identities before their runs. Implementing the runner cannot alter this frozen contract; deviations require a new preregistration before trials.
preregistered_harness_conditions.model: Same configured model/profile and normalized model configuration in both arms; source-owned agent rules hash recorded separately. No adaptive parameter tuning.

budgets.wcl_reader_start: Construct at the original product execution boundary, not lazily at first tool use.
budgets.measurement: Record execution/adapter elapsed time and queue wait separately; HTTP polling wall time is not the480s metric.

preregistered_harness_conditions.path: Actual POST /api/v2/chat/conversations; create only isolated fixture history preserving messages[:-1] role/content order in the candidate database. Final user message goes through authenticated cookie+CSRF+idempotency POST messages/stream, real ChatApplication, durable queue, worker, RegisteredGateway, ToolRecorder and NativeAdapter.stream_for_chat. Apply the real product history20/4000 conversion, permissions and productCapabilities; do not hand-build a native prompt or omit product permissions.
preregistered_harness_conditions.ownership: Two lanes have distinct fixture owners to avoid account-wide busy interference; each sample/repeat uses a new conversation. Preserve real owner-scoped source and SimC capability behavior. Do not disclose secret values or copy private original history into production. Use isolated candidate fixtures only; redact/archive those fixtures after receipt collection without altering originals.
preregistered_harness_conditions.permission_observation: Record candidate database SimC job deltas to evaluate the existing permission criterion; do not trigger additional SimC jobs as a test workaround.
preregistered_harness_conditions.receipts: Save every terminal result including failures, immutable source/model/config/agentRules/harness identities, exact original messages input hash, actual application prompt hash, opaque fixture owner/conversation/run refs, public_error, application-visible recorded tool results after the180000 boundary, tool count/byte sizes/times, final answer, and execution/queue timing. Per-run volatile owner/run values are recorded, not silently removed to fabricate identical prompt hashes.
preregistered_harness_conditions.execution: Run the planned12 baseline and12 candidate trials, preserving each result. No extra retries or replacement model trials after failure; continue collecting planned trials. HTTP200/controllerexit0/terminalcompleted are not semantic success. Independent verdicts bind raw receipt bytes and original fixed criteria. Subsequent HTTP/general release gates remain separate.

independent_review: No blockers; capture/profile/history mismatch and cleanup errors fail gates even when terminal completed.
raw_answers_and_diagnostics: Private; no hidden reasoning or credentials recorded.
